runs.harness: CD — Claude desktop app, local Claude Code session in a fresh clone
runs.invocation:
In the Claude desktop app open a new session in the run's clone, set model Opus 5.5 and effort high, then type:

```
/prime-directive "Trial run A1-cd: follow docs/reports/harness-evals/trial/missions/A1-cd.md exactly"
```

Before sending, set the permission mode to the same no-prompt mode the Oct 7–11 chain used, and confirm the session shows Opus 5.5 at effort high.

runs.harness: CY — Chroxy session, Codex app-server provider (ChatGPT connection)
runs.invocation:
In the Chroxy dashboard: New Session → provider Codex → connection ChatGPT subscription → model gpt-6-astra → reasoning effort xhigh → working directory = the run's clone. Confirm the session header shows gpt-6-astra (not the config default, see #8609). First message:

```
/prompts:prime-directive Trial run B2-cy-codex: follow docs/reports/harness-evals/trial/missions/B2-cy-codex.md exactly
```

If the session does not expand `/prompts:` (app-server sessions may not), paste the full contents of `~/.codex/prompts/prime-directive.md` followed by the line `Trial run B2-cy-codex: follow docs/reports/harness-evals/trial/missions/B2-cy-codex.md exactly`, and note "invocation: pasted prompt" in the run report.

Permission mode: Auto. If the dropdown still says "Auto (unavailable)", stop and tell the supervisor; do not run this attended. The slash prompt did not expand in the dry run (`DRY-RUNS.md`, finding 4), so expect the pasted-prompt fallback above.

runs.harness: CY — Chroxy session, Codex app-server provider (ChatGPT connection)
runs.invocation:
In the Chroxy dashboard: New Session → provider Codex → connection ChatGPT subscription → working directory = the run's clone → Advanced: permission mode Auto, sandbox left on the `Default` option (workspace-write on this daemon, which sets no `CHROXY_CODEX_SANDBOX`), worktree isolation off (the clone is already isolated). After Create, set the session header to model gpt-6-astra and reasoning effort xhigh and confirm both before sending (the header may show the config default first, see #8609). First message:

```
/prompts:prime-directive Trial run B2b-cy-codex: follow docs/reports/harness-evals/trial/missions/B2b-cy-codex.md exactly
```

If the session does not expand `/prompts:`, paste the full contents of `~/.codex/prompts/prime-directive.md` followed by the line `Trial run B2b-cy-codex: follow docs/reports/harness-evals/trial/missions/B2b-cy-codex.md exactly`, and note "invocation: pasted prompt" in the run report.

Permission mode: Auto. If the dropdown says "Auto (unavailable)", stop and tell the supervisor; do not run this attended. The daemon's auto-deploy agent must be unloaded for the whole run (`MAC-BOOTSTRAP.md`, step 9), and the daemon must not be restarted while the run is live: a Codex app-server session cannot be restored by this daemon build, so a restart ends the run.

In the Chroxy dashboard: New Session → provider Claude (SDK) → model claude-opus-5-5 → effort high → worktree isolation off (the clone is already isolated) → working directory = the run's clone. First message:

```
/prime-directive "Trial run A2-cy-claude: follow docs/reports/harness-evals/trial/missions/A2-cy-claude.md exactly"
```

If the slash command is not recognised, send: `Invoke the prime-directive skill with the argument: Trial run A2-cy-claude: follow docs/reports/harness-evals/trial/missions/A2-cy-claude.md exactly` and note "invocation: natural-language skill call" in the run report.

Permission mode: Auto (the dashboard header dropdown; needs `allowAutoPermissionMode: true` in the daemon config). The dashboard's default model is Sonnet 5.5: confirm the header shows Opus 5.5 and the thinking level shows high before sending.

In the Chroxy dashboard: New Session → provider Claude (SDK) → model claude-opus-5-5 → worktree isolation off (the clone is already isolated) → working directory = the run's clone. Effort is not set from the dashboard: the header's thinking level sets a `maxThinkingTokens` budget, not Claude Code's effort level, and at Auto it sets none, so leave it at Auto. Before the session is created, save the level in the user settings so the SDK session inherits it: `~/.claude/settings.json` → `modelSettings` → `claude-opus-5-5` → `effortLevel: "high"`, and confirm it with `grep -A3 modelSettings ~/.claude/settings.json`. First message:

```
/prime-directive "Trial run A2b-cy-claude: follow docs/reports/harness-evals/trial/missions/A2b-cy-claude.md exactly"
```

If the slash command is not recognised, send: `Invoke the prime-directive skill with the argument: Trial run A2b-cy-claude: follow docs/reports/harness-evals/trial/missions/A2b-cy-claude.md exactly` and note "invocation: natural-language skill call" in the run report.

Permission mode: Auto (the dashboard header dropdown; needs `allowAutoPermissionMode: true` in the daemon config). The dashboard's default model is Sonnet 5.5: confirm the header shows Opus 5.5 before sending. The daemon's auto-deploy agent must be unloaded for the whole run (`MAC-BOOTSTRAP.md`, step 9).

In the Chroxy dashboard: New Session → provider Claude (SDK) → worktree isolation off (the clone is already isolated) → working directory = the run's clone. A new dashboard session starts on the dashboard's default model, Sonnet 5.5, so set the model first: in the header pick the Opus 5.5 entry labelled `(provider alias)`, then confirm the daemon recorded it for this session before sending: `grep -n "Model change" ~/.chroxy/logs/chroxy.log | tail -2` must show the new session's id and end with `opus` on both lines. Effort is not set from the dashboard: the header's thinking level sets a `maxThinkingTokens` budget, not Claude Code's effort level, and at Auto it sets none, so leave it at Auto. The level comes from the user settings, which the SDK session inherits: `~/.claude/settings.json` → `modelSettings` → `claude-opus-5-5` → `effortLevel: "high"`; confirm it with `grep -A3 modelSettings ~/.claude/settings.json` before the session is created. First message:

```
/prime-directive "Trial run A2c-cy-claude: follow docs/reports/harness-evals/trial/missions/A2c-cy-claude.md exactly"
```

Press Enter once, then keep your hands off that session: Escape in the composer, Cmd+. and the Stop button that takes Send's place all interrupt the turn, and the slash palette's "No commands found" while typing is cosmetic and closes on send.

If the slash command is not recognised, send: `Invoke the prime-directive skill with the argument: Trial run A2c-cy-claude: follow docs/reports/harness-evals/trial/missions/A2c-cy-claude.md exactly` and note "invocation: natural-language skill call" in the run report.

Permission mode: Auto (the dashboard header dropdown; needs `allowAutoPermissionMode: true` in the daemon config), set before the first message and not changed afterwards. The daemon's auto-deploy agent must be unloaded for the whole run (`MAC-BOOTSTRAP.md`, step 9).

runs.harness: CX — Codex desktop app in a fresh clone
runs.invocation:
In the Codex desktop app open the run's clone, set model gpt-6-astra and reasoning extra-high, then type:

```
/prompts:prime-directive Trial run B1-cx: follow docs/reports/harness-evals/trial/missions/B1-cx.md exactly
```

Approvals: full access, never ask. If `/prompts:` does not expand, Codex reads `~/.codex/prompts/prime-directive.md` itself; that is the expected fallback and goes in the run report as the invocation method.
